newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina shares rise on Q2 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina shares rise on Q2 EPS.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co shares rose 2-1/2 at 81-3/8 after the company posted stronger than expected earnings for the second quarter ended March 31.
Ralston posted earnings of $0.69 a share on a fully diluted basis, compared with the consensus of $0.65, said BT Securities analyst John O'Neil, who had expected earnings of $0.70 a share.
"They blew the doors off the quarter, despite the adverse impact of higher soybean-related raw material costs," he said.
He added that earnings were driven by higher battery profits.

Ralston said its net earnings for the quarter rose 30 percent to $76.7 million due to a strong performance in battery products, higher equity earnings from Interstate Bakeries Corp and lower interest expense. This was partially offset by lower pet product earnings, St. Louis-based Ralston said.

Ralston said operating profit for soy protein products decreased in the second quarter as higher volumes and selling prices were more than offset by higher raw material and business development and management costs.
